steps.title: วันที่วันนี้/เมื่อวาน/เดือนก่อน (ปฏิทินไทย พ.ศ. สำหรับช่องวันที่)
steps.sql: with b as (select (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date d), x as (select d, d - 1 as y, (date_trunc('month', d) - interval '1 month')::date as pf, (date_trunc('month', d)::date - 1) as pt, (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month')::date as nf, (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '2 month')::date - 1 as nt from b) select to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as today, to_char(d, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from d)::int + 543) as today_th, to_char(y, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from y)::int + 543) as yday_th, to_char(pf, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from pf)::int + 543) as pm_from_th, to_char(pt, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from pt)::int + 543) as pm_to_th, to_char(nf, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from nf)::int + 543) as nm_from_th, to_char(nt, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from nt)::int + 543) as nm_to_th, to_char(y, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as yday from x

steps.title: วันที่ในรูปแบบที่รายงานแสดง (ตาม erp_option.year_type)
steps.sql: with b as (select (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date as d, case when (select coalesce(year_type::text, '0') from erp_option limit 1) = '1' then 543 else 0 end as k), x as (select d, k, (date_trunc('month', d) + interval '1 month')::date as nf from b) select to_char(d, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from d)::int + k) as today_r, to_char(nf, 'DD/MM/') || (extract(year from nf)::int + k) as nm_from_r from x

steps.title: เลือกลูกหนี้จริงที่ยังไม่มีเอกสารเลยและไม่ติดวงเงิน (สุ่มตามรอบ)
steps.sql: select m.code as party, (select '^\s*' || string_agg('\u' || lpad(to_hex(ascii(z.ch)), 4, '0'), '\u200b*' order by z.i) || '\s*$' from regexp_split_to_table(m.name_1, '') with ordinality z(ch, i)) as party_rx from ar_customer m where m.code not like 'UAT%' and m.code ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$' and coalesce(m.name_1, '') <> '' and m.name_1 = btrim(m.name_1) and m.name_1 !~ '\s\s' and not exists (select 1 from ic_trans x where x.cust_code = m.code) and not exists (select 1 from ap_ar_trans y where y.cust_code = m.code) and not exists (select 1 from cb_chq_list c where c.ap_ar_code = m.code) and not exists (select 1 from ar_customer_detail cd where cd.ar_code = m.code and (coalesce(cd.credit_status, 0) <> 0 or coalesce(cd.credit_money, 0) <> 0)) order by md5(m.code || :'rs') limit 1

steps.title: เลือกสินค้า/คลัง/ราคา/อัตราภาษี/รูปแบบเลขเอกสารจากบิลขายเชื่อจริงล่าสุด
steps.sql: select coalesce(nullif(t.doc_format_code, ''), 'SI') as fmt, d.item_code as item, d.unit_code as unit, d.wh_code as wh, d.shelf_code as shelf, d.stand_value::text as stand, d.divide_value::text as divide, d.price::text as price, t.vat_rate::text as vat_rate, coalesce((select p.doc_format_code from ap_ar_trans p where p.trans_flag = 239 and p.doc_no not like 'UAT%' and coalesce(p.doc_format_code, '') <> '' order by p.doc_date desc limit 1), 'EE') as pay_fmt from ic_trans t join ic_trans_detail d on d.doc_no = t.doc_no and d.trans_flag = t.trans_flag join ic_inventory i on i.code = d.item_code where t.trans_flag = 44 and t.inquiry_type = 0 and t.vat_type = 0 and t.vat_rate > 0 and t.doc_no not like 'UAT%' and coalesce(t.is_cancel, 0) = 0 and t.last_status = 0 and d.price > 0 and d.price = round(d.price, 2) and d.tax_type = 0 and d.stand_value > 0 and d.divide_value > 0 order by t.doc_date desc, t.roworder desc limit 1

steps.title: เลือกธนาคารจากทะเบียนจริง (หรือธนาคารบนเช็ครับจริง) และสาขาของธนาคารนั้นถ้ามี (สุ่มตามรอบ)
steps.sql: with cand as (select b.code as bank, b.name_1 as nm, 0 as pri from erp_bank b where coalesce(b.code, '') <> '' and coalesce(btrim(b.name_1), '') <> '' and (select count(*) from erp_bank x where x.code = b.code) = 1 union all select distinct c.bank_code, (select b.name_1 from erp_bank b where b.code = c.bank_code limit 1), 1 from cb_chq_list c where c.chq_type = 1 and coalesce(c.bank_code, '') <> '' and (select count(*) from erp_bank x where x.code = c.bank_code) <= 1), pick as (select k.bank, k.nm, br.code as branch, br.name_1 as bnm from cand k left join lateral (select x.code, x.name_1 from erp_bank_branch x where x.bank_code = k.bank and coalesce(x.code, '') <> '' and coalesce(btrim(x.name_1), '') <> '' and (select count(*) from erp_bank_branch y where y.bank_code = x.bank_code and y.code = x.code) = 1 order by md5(x.code || :'rs') limit 1) br on true order by k.pri, (br.code is not null) desc, md5(k.bank || :'rs') limit 1) select bank, coalesce(branch, '') as branch, case when coalesce(btrim(nm), '') = '' then '^\s*$' else (select '^\s*' || string_agg('\u' || lpad(to_hex(ascii(z.ch)), 4, '0'), '\u200b*' order by z.i) || '\s*$' from regexp_split_to_table(regexp_replace(btrim(nm), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), '') with ordinality z(ch, i)) end as bank_rx, case when coalesce(btrim(bnm), '') = '' then '^\s*$' else (select '^\s*' || string_agg('\u' || lpad(to_hex(ascii(z.ch)), 4, '0'), '\u200b*' order by z.i) || '\s*$' from regexp_split_to_table(regexp_replace(btrim(bnm), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), '') with ordinality z(ch, i)) end as branch_rx from pick

steps.title: คำนวณยอดที่คาด: บิล = 2 × ราคา + ภาษี, เช็คใบที่ 1 = มูลค่าก่อนภาษี, เช็คใบที่ 2 = ภาษี
steps.sql: with c as (select round(2 * :'price'::numeric, 2) as b), v as (select b, round(b * :'vat_rate'::numeric / 100, 2) as vt from c) select b::text as base, (b + vt)::text as total, b::text as c1, vt::text as c2, to_char(b + vt, 'FM999,999,999,990.00') as total_f, to_char(b, 'FM999,999,999,990.00') as c1_f, to_char(vt, 'FM999,999,999,990.00') as c2_f from v
